title: MemberPress Members before 3.3.1, with the Block Permissions add-on enabled, contains a denial of service…
description: MemberPress Members versions before 3.3.1 with the Block Permissions add-on enabled have a denial of service vulnerability. Authenticated users with Author-level permissions can cause fatal PHP errors by saving a non-string value in the blockPermissionsMessage attribute, leading to crashes on various pages for unauthorized viewers.
